title: Console integration
summary: How the console works with this profile: pane hooks, the /done chip, the DONE band and the scheduler view.
why: The console already provides these; listing them here shows how they connect to the rest of the profile and lets you see each one's reason in the same place.

items.title: Turn-state hooks for console panes
items.does: Passes the console's turn-state hooks to each pane as an additive settings file, so nothing is installed globally.
items.why: The console knows when a pane is working or waiting without ever editing your account settings.
items.notes: Built into the console (setup item pane-hooks); nothing is written by the profile.

items.title: /done chip in the composer
items.does: Offers a /done chip in each pane's composer that runs the repository's own /done, or the console's plain one when there is none.
items.why: Ending a session cleanly should be one click, not a command to remember.
items.notes: The repository's own /done (from the session module) wins over the console's.

items.title: DONE band from the verified marker
items.does: Shows a DONE band on a pane only when the done marker validates against the pane, HEAD, the hand-off hash and the last prompt time.
items.why: DONE has to be verified and persistent; a band that trusted chat text could say done when it was not.

items.title: Scheduler view with backup and read-back
items.does: Lists, adds, changes and removes Windows scheduled tasks with an XML backup first and a read-back after; every profile task goes through it.
items.why: Consent, backup and rollback for scheduled tasks belong in one place, the same one every task uses.
items.notes: It writes nothing itself; the profile's per-task consent step uses this engine.
